title: Explosive Collar
description: Adds items - explosive collar and detonator. You can use detonator to explode someone with explosive collar.
body:
This datapack adds 2 craftable items.

Explosive Collar and Detonator

On anvil if you give Explosive Collar and Detonator same name they will be connected.

When you activate renamed Detonator by right clicking a player, that wears Explosive Collar that has
the same name as Detonator, will explode.


Have fun!
